# Tool reference

MCP tools exposed by `agent-todo serve --mcp`. Regenerate with `bun run docs:tool-reference`.

## Core toolset

- **`task_next`** — Claim next ready task: pass project for project-wide or group to stay in one feature.
- **`task_get`** — Get one task.
- **`task_list`** — List tasks.
- **`task_create`** — Create one or more tasks in a group; tags select context sections.
- **`task_update`** — Update task.
- **`task_status`** — Set task status.
- **`comment_add`** — Add comment.
- **`comment_list`** — List comments.
- **`context_get`** — Get group context; the first group (project code plus -1) is project context, written with context_update when it has no section text, and read by passing that group id.
- **`changes_since`** — Events since rev.

- **`docs`** — Return the fixed agent-todo usage guide.

## Plan toolset

- **`group_create`** — Create a task group.
- **`group_update`** — Update group metadata.
- **`group_list`** — List groups.
- **`group_get`** — Get group summary and context TOC.
- **`context_update`** — Patch context sections.
- **`context_import`** — Import markdown sections.
- **`context_export`** — Export context markdown.
- **`comment_compact`** — Compact task comments.
- **`task_claim`** — Claim a task.
- **`task_release`** — Release a task claim.
- **`task_move`** — Move task to another group.

## Admin toolset

- **`task_archive`** — Archive a task.
- **`group_archive`** — Archive a group.
- **`history`** — List entity event history.


## Optional

- **`context_generate`** — Draft context via client sampling (plan toolset / sampling).
